patterns: Dark-humor relatable skit wins big: techhalla's 'if you ever become a CEO you'd better have an escape plan' hit 401.5K views, 7,582 likes and 1,082 bookmarks - a one-line punchline over a cinematic AI clip, no tool talk at all.

Fable 5.2 creative demos are the new meta: EHuanglu's 'fable 5.2 now can turn storyboard into disney level animation' did 55.1K with 880 bookmarks (bookmarks ≈ likes = save-worthy), plus 'Fable 5.2 used an RTX 5090 to render an ad for that same 5090 in Blender' (10.9K).
News recaps keep compounding: minchoi's second Gemini 4 Hydrogen '10 examples' thread reached 135.2K (after 85.8K the day before).

AI VFX in Hollywood is a hot narrative: minchoi's 'Hollywood is literally bringing AI VFX onto movie sets' (Young Washington, footage in 30 seconds) did 34.9K and 'AI could create MORE filmmaking jobs' 13.9K; EHuanglu's 'best AI trailer so far' 14.2K.

'X but it's 197x' still works when tied to the calendar: techhalla's 'Friday the 13th but it's 1971' 12.3K, while maxescu's World of Warcraft 1984 versions stayed under 2.6K. Outside the watchlist, the sample was low-reach (under 5K): MiniMax H3 vs Seedance 2.5 cost comparisons and 'big week of releases' recaps.

Hollywood is putting AI VFX on set now.

I worked AI VFX on House of David S2. Here's what changes when footage comes back in seconds instead of weeks 👇
drafts.video_tip: 10-15s: split screen - raw plate on the left, AI VFX shot on the right, a timer counting '00:30'. End on the final shot full screen. Breakdown thread in the replies.

drafts.draft_en:
Storyboard → final VFX shot.

Same frames, same timing. One afternoon.

Which panel surprised you most? 👇
drafts.video_tip: 8-12s: show 4 rough storyboard panels for 2s, then wipe each one into its finished animated shot in order. Keep labels only 1-4. Tools and prompts in the reply.
